fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M6WMVHAJBBHR9SFTRPZD8CHC (bug). Reading internal/run showed the cause: a retry keeps a leaves step's leaf states, and on entry reviveLeaves gives a fresh round only to a failed leaf whose own failure question has an answering Decision (in an autonomous run, only in round 1, through the arbiter). The leaf bugfix-workflow-autonomous had spent both rounds while blocked on a different question raised by its builder, so the retry found nothing to start and failed at once. The planner asked whether a retry should give every failed leaf a fresh round, or only when a blocker was answered or the branch moved; there was no owner, and the arbiter ruled every failed leaf (Decision retry-revives-every-failed-leaf). The planner linked the change set to milestone 25 (the daemon ships the backlog on its own), since a retry that cannot rebuild forces an abandon and a new run by hand. Planned one leaf under build-workflow: a retry journals a leaf-round marked as the retry's for each failed leaf, its skipped dependents reopen, the builder prompt and run status name the retry round, and a failure in it is not arbitrated again.
fields.title: Plan: rhiza run resume --retry rebuilds failed leaves
